Name: Miihau Event Helper
Author: Miihau
Description:
I needed a firefly effect for an event and decided to make a helper mod because I couldn't find a good way to do it otherwise.
Over time I added a few more things I needed for my events. I will probably keep expanding this mod whenever I need something new.
Currently there are [b][u]3[/u][/b] event actions and [b][u]4[/u][/b] Content Patcher tokens.

[size=4][b]Action 1 and 2:[/b][/size]
[u]Fireflies[/u]

        ///    Usage:
        ///    action MiihauEventHelper_SpawnFirefly <tileX> <tileY> [durationMs] [baseRadius] [pulseAmplitude] [pulseSpeed] [color] [movementSpeed] [fadeInDurationMs] [fireflyId]
        ///
        ///    Example:
        ///    action MiihauEventHelper_SpawnFirefly 6 7 5000 0.9 0.1 0.3 #FF4938 15 3000 introGlow
        ///
        ///    Then later:
        ///    Usage:
        ///    action MiihauEventHelper_RemoveFireFly <id> [fadeOutDurationMs]
        ///
        ///    Example:
        ///    action MiihauEventHelper_RemoveFireFly introGlow

Example Event:
[code]{
"Action": "EditData",
"Target": "Data/Events/Forest",
"Entries":
{
"{{ModId}}_fireFliesTest/F":"
    none/76 76/farmer 76 76 2/skippable/
    pause 1000/
    action MiihauEventHelper_SpawnFirefly 76 76 0 0.5 0.2 0.2 #863DFF 20 3000 firefly1/
    message \"after firefly 1\"/
    action MiihauEventHelper_SpawnFirefly 84 72 0 0.5 0.1 0.25 #863DFF 25 3500 firefly2/
    pause 300/
    action MiihauEventHelper_SpawnFirefly 83 76 0 0.55 0.13 0.15 #863DFF 25 2000 firefly3/
    pause 100/
    action MiihauEventHelper_SpawnFirefly 78 72 0 0.55 0.13 0.15 #863DFF 30 2000 firefly4/
    message \"after adding more firefly\"/
    action MiihauEventHelper_RemoveFirefly firefly1 3000/
    message \"after removing firefly 1\"/
    pause 2000/
    message \"now spawning firefly with 3 second timer\"/
    action MiihauEventHelper_SpawnFirefly 34 12 3000/
    pause 3000/
    message \"timed firefly removed\"/
    pause 1000/
    end/
    ",
}
},[/code]

[size=4][b]Action 3:[/b][/size]
[u]CustomEmote[/u]

This allows you to use sprites from other sprite sheets as emotes above characters. I mainly made this because the normal emotes weren't enough for some of my events.

///    Usage:
///    action MiihauEventHelper_CustomEmote <actor> <PathToSpriteFile> <XposInSprite> <YposInSprite> <width> <height> [YOffset = 0]
///
///    Example:
///    action MiihauEventHelper_CustomEmote Abigail Characters\\Emily 1 4 15 13 12

Example Event:
[code]{
"Action": "EditData",
"Target": "Data/Events/Forest",
"Entries":

    pause 1000/

    pause 1000/

    pause 1000/

[size=5][b]Content Patcher Tokens[/b][/size]

I added a few tokens for checking maps. I needed this because Stardew Valley Expanded moves the mine entrance depending on its config, which caused problems for one of my events.
These tokens can be used in Content Patcher's "When" conditions to check if certain things exist on a map.
You can use them for other maps and mods too, not just SVE.

[b]All tokens return true or false.[/b]
Coordinates are optional. If you don't specify them, the token will search the entire map.

[size=4][b]Token 1:[/b][/size]
[u]HasWarp[/u]

Checks if a map contains a normal warp. You can also check where the warp leads to.
Examples:
[code]"MiihauEventHelper/HasWarp: Mountain": "true"

"MiihauEventHelper/HasWarp: Mountain, Mine": "true"

"MiihauEventHelper/HasWarp: Mountain, Mine, 54, 8": "true"

"MiihauEventHelper/HasWarp: Mountain, Mine, 54, 8, 3": "true"[/code]The last example checks within 3 tiles of the given coordinates.

[size=4][b]Token 2:[/b][/size]
[u]HasAction[/u]

Checks if a map contains a tile with an Action property.
For example, this can be a shop, a door, or some other interaction.

Examples:
[code]"MiihauEventHelper/HasAction: Town": "true"

"MiihauEventHelper/HasAction: Town, Shop": "true"

"MiihauEventHelper/HasAction: Town, 10, 15, Shop": "true"[/code]
You can also check for a specific action value instead of just the action name.
[code]"MiihauEventHelper/HasAction: Town, Shop |value=Shop Pierre": "true"[/code]
[size=4][b]Token 3:[/b][/size]
[u]HasTouchAction[/u]

Pretty much the same as HasAction, but for TouchAction properties.
These are usually triggered when walking onto a tile instead of interacting with it.

Examples:
[code]"MiihauEventHelper/HasTouchAction: Mountain": "true"

"MiihauEventHelper/HasTouchAction: Mountain, MagicWarp": "true"

"MiihauEventHelper/HasTouchAction: Mountain, 19, 14, MagicWarp": "true"[/code]
[size=4][b]Token 4:[/b][/size]
[u]HasTileProperty[/u]

This one is a little more general.
It checks if a tile has a specific property on a given map layer.
This can be used for Action and TouchAction properties too, but also things like Passable or other tile properties.

Examples:
[code]"MiihauEventHelper/HasTileProperty: Mountain, Buildings, Passable": "true"

"MiihauEventHelper/HasTileProperty: Mountain, Buildings, 54, 8, Passable": "true"

"MiihauEventHelper/HasTileProperty: Town, Buildings, Action |value=Shop Pierre": "true"[/code]Unlike the other tokens, you need to specify the map layer for this one.


[size=4][b]Optional arguments[/b][/size]

You can also use a radius when checking coordinates.

For example:
[code]"MiihauEventHelper/HasAction: Town, 10, 15, Shop |radius=3": "true"[/code]
This checks a square area around the given tile, instead of only that exact tile.
A radius of 0 checks only the given position.
For HasAction and HasTouchAction, you can also specify the layer to check:
[code]"MiihauEventHelper/HasAction: Town, Shop |layer=Buildings": "true"[/code]Without this, those two tokens check all map layers.

[size=4][b]Example use in Content Patcher[/b][/size]

Here is an example for checking whether the mine entrance has been moved by Stardew Valley Expanded.
[code]{
    "Action": "Include",
    "FromFile": "events/Event1_SVE.json",
    "When": {
        "HasMod": "FlashShifter.StardewValleyExpandedCP",
        "MiihauEventHelper/HasWarp: Mountain, Mine, 54, 8, 3": "false",
        "MiihauEventHelper/HasWarp: Custom_AdventurerSummit, Mine, 19, 14, 3": "true"
    }
}[/code]This way the SVE version of an event only gets loaded when the mine entrance is at Adventurer Summit and not at the original Mountain location.

[b]A few things to keep in mind:[/b]

[list]
[*]HasWarp only checks normal map warps. Warps made using Action or TouchAction properties need to be checked with the corresponding token.[/*]
[*]The tokens check if something exists on the map, not whether the player can currently use it.[/*]
[*]Custom interactions added entirely through C# might not be detected.[/*]
[*]Coordinates are tile coordinates, not pixel coordinates.[/*]
[*]The map checking tokens require Content Patcher.[/*]
[/list]
I mainly added these for compatibility with other mods that change maps, but they should be useful for other things too.
If I need more functions for my events in the future, I'll probably add them here.
